decision.explanation: Remove row 2 and column 3 of P. The remaining rows are (-7, 3, 1), (-2, 0, 2), and (11, 3, -3), giving option b.

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${p}_{23}$, we remove the  $2$nd row and the $3$rd column:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & ∗ & 1 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ -2 & 0 & ∗ & 2 \\ 11 & 3 & ∗ & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & \,1 \\ -2 & 0 & \,2 \\ 11 & 3 & \,-3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Question 1
?

What is the minor of p23 in P=[−7301101−10−20321130−3]?

a
|−70110−10−202|
b
|−731−202113−3|
c
 |3011−10032|
d
|1010−202113−3|
e
|−70110−10110−3|
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of p23, we remove the 2nd row and the 3rd column:

P=[−73∗1∗∗−1∗−20∗2113∗−3]

So, the minor is

M23=|−731−202113−3|.

verification.explanation: Deleting row 2 and column 3 leaves rows (-7, 3, 1), (-2, 0, 2), and (11, 3, -3). This matches option b and the revealed worked solution.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${p}_{23}$, we remove the  $2$nd row and the $3$rd column:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & ∗ & 1 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ -2 & 0 & ∗ & 2 \\ 11 & 3 & ∗ & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & \,1 \\ -2 & 0 & \,2 \\ 11 & 3 & \,-3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Question 2
?

Find the minor of e14 in E=[3558513−700225−13−20−5380734252].

a
|13−70225−130−5387342|
b
|3−7005−13−2−538034252|
c
|13−70225−1−20−53073452|
d
|355813−70225−130−538|
e
|358513002253−20−58073252|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of e14, we remove the 1st row and 4th column:

E=[∗∗∗8∗13−7∗0225−1∗−20−53∗0734∗52]

So, the minor is M14=|13−70225−1−20−53073452|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${e}_{14}$, we remove the $1$st row and $4$th column:

$$
E=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 8 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & -7 & ∗ & 0 \\ 22 & 5 & -1 & ∗ & -2 \\ 0 & -5 & 3 & ∗ & 0 \\ 7 & 3 & 4 & ∗ & \frac{5}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

 

So, the minor is

$$
{M}_{14}=|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -7 & 0 \\ 22 & 5 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & -5 & 3 & 0 \\ 7 & 3 & 4 & \frac{5}{2}\end{aligned}|.
$$

after.name: Question 3
after.problem: What is the minor of ${u}_{34}$ in  $U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ 7 & 10 & 2 & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]?$
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${u}_{34}$, we remove the  $3$rd row and the $4$th column:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & ∗ \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 \\ 9 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

EXPLANATION

verification.explanation: Deleting row 3 and column 4 leaves (2, -1, 1), (5, -1, 0), and (9, -3, 0). This matches option d and the revealed worked solution.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.problem: What is the minor of ${u}_{34}$ in  $U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ 7 & 10 & 2 & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]?$
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${u}_{34}$, we remove the  $3$rd row and the $4$th column:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & ∗ \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 \\ 9 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

after.name: Question 4
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${u}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -3 & 0 & 8 & 6 \\ ∗ & 2 & -2 & 3 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 3 & \sqrt{3} \\ ∗ & -5 & 4 & 6 & 13 \\ 7 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 

So, the minor is

$$

Question 4
?

Find the minor of u51 in U=[5−308682−230950331−5461373−63−18].

a
|82−2395031−54673−63|
b
|−30862−2305033−54613|
c
|5−30682−2095031−5413|
d
|82−2095031−541373−6−18|
e
|5−30882−231−54673−63|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of u51, we remove the 5th row and 1st column:

U=[∗−3086∗2−230∗5033∗−546137∗∗∗∗]

So, the minor is M51=|−30862−2305033−54613|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${u}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -3 & 0 & 8 & 6 \\ ∗ & 2 & -2 & 3 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 3 & \sqrt{3} \\ ∗ & -5 & 4 & 6 & 13 \\ 7 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 

So, the minor is

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 & 8 & 6 \\ 2 & -2 & 3 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 3 & \sqrt{3} \\ -5 & 4 & 6 & 13\end{aligned}|.
$$

after.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & 1 & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{12}$, we remove the $1$st row and $2$nd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 0 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 3 & ∗ & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & ∗ & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{12}=|\begin{aligned}3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

Question 5
?

What is the minor of x12 in X=[501−23311721−88−641−2]?

a
|337218−64−2|
b
|31171−8841−2|
c
|31172−88−61−2|
d
|501331121−8|
e
|01−231171−88|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of x12, we remove the 1st row and 2nd column:

X=[∗0∗∗3∗1172∗−88−6∗1−2]

So, the minor is

M12=|31172−88−61−2|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & 1 & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{12}$, we remove the $1$st row and $2$nd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 0 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 3 & ∗ & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & ∗ & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{12}=|\begin{aligned}3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

after.name: Question 6
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of d15, we remove the 1st row and 5th column:

D=[∗∗∗∗208−20∗62−94∗1521∗−14310∗] So, the minor is M15=|08−2062−941521−14310|. Therefore, the cofactor of d15 is C15=(−1)1+5M15=M15=|08−2062−941521−14310|.

verification.explanation: Removing row 1 and column 5 gives the determinant in option b. Since (-1)^(1+5)=1, the cofactor equals this minor, as confirmed by the revealed solution.

content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Delete row 3 and column 4 to form the minor. Since (-1)^(3+4)=-1, negate its determinant, giving option e.

after.name: Question 7
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{34}$, we remove the $3$rd row and the $4$th column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -2 \\ -7 & 0 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{34}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{34} & =(-1)^{3+4}{M}_{34} \\  & =-{M}_{34} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 7

Find the cofactor of b34 in B=[−22301305021−2−7003].

a
|−230105−703|
b
−|−22013502−2|
c
|−22013502−2|
d
|−22002−2−703|
e
−|−223130−700|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of b34, we remove the 3rd row and the 4th column:

B=[−223∗130∗∗∗∗−2−700∗]

So, the minor is M34=|−223130−700|.

Therefore, the cofactor of b34 is

C34=(−1)3+4M34=−M34=−|−223130−700|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{34}$, we remove the $3$rd row and the $4$th column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -2 \\ -7 & 0 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{34}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{34} & =(-1)^{3+4}{M}_{34} \\  & =-{M}_{34} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 8
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ ∗ & 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 6 & 8 & 3 \\ 11 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${d}_{51}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{51} & =(-1)^{5+1}{M}_{51} \\  & ={M}_{51} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the cofactor of d51 in D=[−5−820135071−10−56−4406831130−93].

a
|3507−10−5640681130−9|
b
|−5−8203507−10−564068|
c
|−820150710−56−40683|
d
−|−820150710−56−40683|

−|3507−10−5640681130−9|
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of d51, we remove the 5th row and 1st column:

D=[∗−8201∗5071∗0−56−4∗068311∗∗∗∗]

So, the minor is

M51=|−820150710−56−40683|.

Now, the cofactor of d51 is

C51=(−1)5+1M51=M51=|−820150710−56−40683|.

verification.explanation: Removing row 5 and column 1 gives the determinant in option c. The sign factor is (-1)^(5+1)=1, so the cofactor equals this minor, agreeing with the revealed solution.

content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ ∗ & 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 6 & 8 & 3 \\ 11 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${d}_{51}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{51} & =(-1)^{5+1}{M}_{51} \\  & ={M}_{51} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 9
?

Find the cofactor of x52 in X=[1−82−5−135631−1−1−56−445383−937−90].

a
−|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
b
|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
c
|1−82−53563−1−1−564538|
d
|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
e
−|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of x52, we remove the 5th row and 2nd column:

X=[1∗2−5−13∗631−1∗−56−44∗383∗3∗∗∗]

So, the minor is

M52=|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|.

Now, the cofactor of x52 is

C52=(−1)5+2M52=−M52=−|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|.

decision.explanation: Delete row 1 and column 3 of A. Since (-1)^(1+3)=1, the cofactor equals the resulting determinant, matching option a.

after.name: Question 10
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{13}$,  we remove the $1$st row and the $3$rd column:

$$
A=|\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 2 & ∗ & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & ∗ & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${a}_{13}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{13} & =(-1)^{1+3}{M}_{13} \\  & ={M}_{13} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 10
?

Find the cofactor of a13 in A=[3−51400201−707−2523−5116−2104−3].

a
|021−707523−516−214−3|
b
|3−54007523−516−214−3|
c
|−5140201−7−5116104−3|
d
|001−70−2523116−204−3|
e
|3−540021−73−516−214−3|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of a13, we remove the 1st row and the 3rd column: A=|∗∗1∗∗02∗1−707∗523−5∗16−21∗4−3|.

So, the minor is M13=|021−707523−516−214−3|. Therefore, the cofactor of a13 is C13=(−1)1+3M13=M13=|021−707523−516−214−3|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{13}$,  we remove the $1$st row and the $3$rd column:

$$
A=|\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 2 & ∗ & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & ∗ & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${a}_{13}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{13} & =(-1)^{1+3}{M}_{13} \\  & ={M}_{13} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 7 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & -5 & 1 & 6 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 13
after.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}].$
after.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{11}-{C}_{13} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ ∗ & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & ∗ & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & ∗ & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 5 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|)-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & -3 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}|) \\  & =0+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0-(0-0+0) \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =2((-3)\cdot 5-4\cdot 4) \\  & =2\cdot (-31) \\  & =-62\end{aligned}
$$

after.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(U) & ={u}_{11}{C}_{11}+{u}_{12}{C}_{12}+{u}_{13}{C}_{13}+{u}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =5\cdot {C}_{11}+(-2)\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =5{C}_{11}-2{C}_{12} \\  & =5\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & -2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & ∗ & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & ∗ & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+2|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|)+2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -3 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -3 & 5\end{aligned}|) \\  & =5(0-(6\cdot (-4)-1\cdot 2)+0)+2(0-(3\cdot (-4)-1\cdot (-3))+0) \\  & =5\cdot 26+2\cdot 9 \\  & =130+18 \\  & =148\end{aligned}
